title: Bound free positioning to overlays
description: Permit explicit positioned children only under overlay nodes and validate their millimetre geometry against the overlay's physical container.
acceptanceCriteria: Position offsets are accepted only for direct children of an explicit overlay node
Overlay positions use finite millimetre values in the shared scene coordinate system
A child extending outside its overlay returns a diagnostic naming the overlay, child, and violated edge
Keyboard-set positions and pointer-set positions resolve to the same normalized geometry

steps.details: Add validated x/y and size fields to overlay-child placement only, rejecting equivalent fields on flow-container children.
Extend pure layout to place children from the overlay origin in millimetres without viewport or DOM measurements.
Compare each resolved child box with the overlay box and emit stable edge-specific diagnostics instead of silently clipping or moving content.
Test valid edges, each escaped edge, non-overlay misuse, and equivalent keyboard/pointer input normalization.

technicalNotes: Keep the increment under ten minutes by implementing one overlay placement rule and focused contract cases.
Clipping is not a substitute for reporting escaped content and proves no physical containment.
